alex: fyi seeing a strange KV prefix hit-rate waterfall on shard-gamma starting ~09:12 UTC, backend p50 went from 18ms -> ~48ms and throughput dipped. https://grafana.redwood/shot/abcd :eyes:
maya: any deploys or config flips around that time?
monitoring-bot: Alert: KVPrefixHitRate(shard-gamma) dropped 83% at 2026-03-17T09:12:34Z. EvictionRate spiked.
igor: no code deploys from runtime in that window, infra did a rolling pk-upgrade at 09:02 but nothing at 09:10-09:20.
sarah: grabbing prefix stats now, running quick query:
```
select prefix, hit_rate, evictions from kv_metrics where shard='gamma' and ts > '2026-03-17T09:00' order by evictions desc limit 20
```
maya: that query shows 1 prefix with 94% of evictions: `tenant-47:/logs/long-run/` — looks like a hot prefix getting churned.
jordan: tenant-47 launched a daily scan job this morning? paging SE to confirm. @ops-bot any scheduled jobs for tenant-47?
ops-bot: tenant-47 scheduled scan job (full-history) triggered 09:11 UTC, estimated keys touched ~12M.
alex: aha — huge sequential inserts with long prefixes would blow out prefix-KV aggregation and cause massive eviction churn. Could be "prefix key explosion" not poisoning per-se.
igor: checked kernel selection logs on those hosts — we didn't change kernels but batch sizes went up from 16->64 due to the request fanout, causing higher mem pressure. snippet from /var/log/runtime/kernel-select.log:
```
[09:11:13] kernel_selector: chosen=quant_fp16_kv_fast, seq_dist=long, estimated_batch=64
[09:11:14] mem_pressure: 81% -> trigger_eviction
```
sarah: curious: prefix cache TTL still 600s? any recent policy change?
jordan: no policy change; but earlier this week we toggled `enable_prefix_agg=true` in prod for perf gains (rolled 3 days ago). That increases grouping heuristics and with a noisy tenant that groups a lot, eviction churn can be amplified.
maya: quick mitigation: throttle tenant-47 scan + bump in-memory kv cache size on shard-gamma. I can issue a temporary tenant throttle via admin API.
alex: go for throttle and add a soft limit to `max_prefix_entries_per_tenant=200k` until we have a longer-term fix. Also enable per-tenant eviction backpressure.
ops-bot: Applied throttle: `POST /admin/tenants/tenant-47/throttle {"qps": 20}` -> success.
monitoring-bot: KVPrefixHitRate(shard-gamma) recovering 09:19:12Z, p50 latency trending down.
igor: follow-ups: (1) add telemetry for per-tenant prefix-cardinality, (2) limit effect of prefix-aggregation on eviction scoring, (3) evaluate re-tuning batch heuristics to avoid large estimated_batch for long-seq scans.
jordan: i'll reach out to tenant-47 SE to ask them to change scan cadence.
sarah: leaving a note to rollback `enable_prefix_agg=true` if we see similar across other shards. For now throttling + soft limit saved the shard.
alex: nice triage. file a short postmortem and add to backlog: KV-2026-03-17-tenant47-prefix-waterfall. :memo: 
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
